samples.question: What is actually present at the point of strongest signal?
samples.rationale: Highest spectral anomaly in the event (RX 14). The strongest signal gives laboratory analysis the best chance of identifying what is actually present.

samples.question: Has anything reached the protected asset yet?
analytes: Algal toxins if a bloom is suspected
samples.rationale: Nearest analysable water to Port of Fujairah, 2767 m away. This is the measurement that answers whether the asset is affected yet.

samples.question: Where is the boundary, and is the event advancing?
samples.rationale: Edge of the event nearest the modelled drift direction (bearing 298deg). Sampling here tests whether the event is advancing and how sharp the front is.

samples.question: What does unaffected water in this body read today?
analytes: Same analyte suite as the event core, for direct comparison
samples.rationale: Lowest-anomaly water at least 800 m offshore (RX -6.7). Without a same-day control, an absolute laboratory value from the event cannot be interpreted.

samples.question: Where is the interpretation least certain?
samples.rationale: Marginal anomaly (RX between the 85th and 97th percentile) in shallow water, where bottom reflectance and suspended matter are hard to separate optically. A depth reading and a TSS sample here would resolve the ambiguity for the whole nearshore band.

incidents.title: Spatial anomaly stood down: persistent coastal feature
incidents.summary: RX flags a 1.13 km² nearshore region at the 99.7th percentile of the scene's water, with a sediment-like spectrum. Against 428 Sentinel-2 observations of the same zone (2020-2025) it sits at the 6.6th seasonal percentile: cleaner than usual. BlueBan stands down. This is the false-alarm suppression the product is built around.

temporal.note: Zone P95 of the turbidity proxy against 106 same-season Sentinel-2 observations.

algorithm.name: BLUEBAN 813 cascade v0.1.0
algorithm.description: Quality screening -> MNDWI water mask with shoreline erosion -> uncertainty-propagated indices -> water-informative band selection by measured SNR -> RX anomaly in PCA space with empirically calibrated threshold -> optical fingerprinting -> wind-driven drift -> asset exposure -> separated severity/confidence -> sampling plan.
algorithm.reference: See docs/METHODOLOGY.md for the full citation list.

parameters.rx_threshold_rule: empirical percentile of background RX distribution

assumptions: Tanager surface reflectance is comparable across the scene.
Offshore water is a valid optical background for nearshore water.
Wind-driven drift at 3% of 10 m wind approximates surface transport.
limitations: No in-situ measurement available for this AOI.
Bottom reflectance cannot be excluded for nearshore detections from a single scene.
The drift model is not hydrodynamic.

assets.name: Annaba fishing harbour
assets.notes: Working fishing harbour on the Annaba waterfront. Harbour water quality is both an operational and a compliance concern, and harbours are chronic turbidity sources in their own right.

assets.name: Annaba Port power station
assets.notes: A 72 MW thermal power station on the harbour. Thermal plants draw large volumes of seawater for condenser cooling, so suspended sediment and biofouling load in the source water directly affect screen and heat-exchanger performance. Placed at the mapped plant centroid, not at an intake structure.

assets.name: Plage Chapuis
assets.notes: Named public beach on the Annaba seafront, roughly 2.5 km north of the harbour. Bathing-water quality is a public-health and compliance matter.

assets.name: Plage Ain Achir
assets.notes: Named public beach north of the city, near the Cap de Garde headland. Included as a second bathing-water receptor at a materially different distance from the detected event.

assets.name: Cap de Garde lighthouse
assets.notes: Fixed navigational landmark on the Cap de Garde headland, used here as a far-field coastal reference station. It is NOT designated as a marine protected area in OpenStreetMap, and no protected-area designation inside this AOI could be verified, so none is claimed.
